title: Diagnose a failed CI check and repair the workspace until local verify passes
narrative: Fangore's pull request build fails on the checks job. He starts guided coding against the project workspace, reads the failed check log, repairs the broken source, re-runs the same kind of local verify the pipeline used, and writes a short fix note for the next human review. GitHub Actions itself stays mocked in stories so CI and live Completer walks do not need forge credentials; only the local edit and verify are real. Complements `fangore_coding_git_inspect` and `fangore_coding_git_open_pr`. The production path will fetch check and job logs over the injectable GitHub HTTP client when a token is present.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `guided_coding` with `environment.local_work: project_coding`, `ci_seed: failing_check`, and coding tools under `build_coding_tool_registry`. Static stories plant a failure log and broken module; the Completer (or `coding_tool_script: ci_repair`) reads that log, edits the module, and records `.mechaharness/ci_fix.md`. Production extends `GitHubClient` / `HttpGitHubClient` with check-run and job-log fetch (bound via `GitHubConnectionConfig` / `ProjectCodingConfig.get_github_client()`), exposing confined tools such as `ci_checks` and `ci_job_log` beside existing git/PR tools. Local re-check uses `ProjectCodingLocalWork` `verify_runs` / `run_python` (and host `run_checks.sh` when bound) so repair stays on the cheap Completer lane. Soft point `external_guidance` remains the human scope gate.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `repair.yaml` in suite `fangore_guided_coding`. Static mode uses `coding_tool_script: ci_repair` against `ci_seed: failing_check`. Asserts `widget.py` contains the repaired function and `.mechaharness/ci_fix.md` cites the failure. Live Completer may drive the same tools with `MECHA_STORY_BACKEND=live`. Unit coverage for HTTP check/log fetch lands in `tests/test_github_client.py` when those methods ship; until then the story proves the diagnose→edit→note loop on seeded artifacts.
